question: What caused MV Ocean Starlight's delay on its September voyage?

rows.statement: Ocean Starlight berthed on 27 Sep at 22:00 UTC.
Ocean Starlight berthed 16 hours behind its original ETA.

rows.quote: Delay due to engine cooling fault mid-voyage
rows.statement: Ocean Starlight had an engine cooling fault mid-voyage, which caused delay.
A late pilot contributed to the delay of Ocean Starlight.

headline.text: The September voyage VG-1011 (Shanghai to Felixstowe) was delayed 16 hours. A Confirmed engine cooling fault explains 14 of those hours. A late pilot is reported by an agent but unverified, and it is not quantified.

interpretation.text: 'September voyage' is read as VG-1011, the only voyage of V003 overlapping September 2026. It sailed CNSHA to GBFXT, with original ETA 27 Sep 06:00 UTC and revised ETA 27 Sep 22:00 UTC.

confirmed_facts.text: Incident INC-160, an engine cooling fault, is Confirmed. It was reported from the master's report and carries 14 hours of attributed delay.
The vessel berthed at Felixstowe at 22:00 UTC on 27 Sep, after anchoring at 20:00 UTC. This matches the revised ETA, and the berth window had closed at 16:00 UTC.

unverified_reports.text: Harwich Port Services (agent) said the vessel berthed 16 hours behind its original ETA. The 16 hours is unverified as a message fact, but it matches the recorded delay.
The same agent said a late pilot contributed to the delay. Only this message reports it, and no hours are given.

inferences.text: The 2 hours not covered by the engine fault may be the late pilot, but the data does not say so. Until the pilot report is verified, treat those 2 hours as unexplained.
inferences.based_on: 16 recorded hours minus 14 attributed hours, plus an unquantified unverified pilot report

data_gaps.text: The incident has no precise time ('mid-voyage'). No pilot-delay incident record exists, only the agent's message. I did not check congestion at Felixstowe, so port conditions are unassessed.

cited_values.value: Delay due to engine cooling fault mid-voyage

recommended_checks.text: Ask Harwich Port Services or the Felixstowe pilotage for the pilot's booked and actual boarding times, to confirm the late pilot and how many hours it cost.
